column2: the plan updates shared emit contract and `skills/design/skill.md`, but leaves `skills/design/references/finalize-step5.md` (loaded at step 5 entry and on step 5c abort/handoff paths) directing orchestrators to extract summary bodies from `<task-notification>` stdout via the marker-first profile. after `_emit_final_summary_marked_from_disk` emits empty readiness markers only, stale prose yields empty chat, skips the read path, and keeps harness greps at `scripts/test-render-cost-line-callsites.sh:125` failing.

the plan lists cancellation wording at `:220` and step 5c sites but not the final summary block parameters/wait lines (`after present: proceed to marker extraction or the read fallback`; `wait for <task-notification> before extracting final-summary markers...`). those always-loaded lines contradict the read-always contract and can keep orchestrators extracting marker bodies from truncated stdout after python stops emitting bodies.
